questions.stem: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) was launched in February 2019. What is the annual financial benefit to eligible farmers?

options.option_text: ₹6,000 in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months

questions.explanation: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 per year (₹500/month equivalent) to eligible small & marginal farmer families, transferred DIRECTLY to bank accounts (DBT) in THREE equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months (Apr-Jul, Aug-Nov, Dec-Mar). Launched on 24 February 2019 (announced in Interim Budget 2019-20). Nodal ministry: AGRICULTURE + FARMERS WELFARE. Initially for small+marginal (≤2 hectares), extended to all farmers (Dec 2019). Excludes: institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, former/present Ministers, serving/retired employees with pension ≥ ₹10k/month, income-tax payers, professionals. As of 2024, over 11 crore farmers have benefitted, with total disbursal exceeding ₹3 lakh crore across 18+ instalments. Related: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (pension for farmers ≥60 years, 2019).

questions.stem: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PRADHAN MANTRI JAN ARGOYA YOJANA (PMJAY), launched in 2018, provides annual health cover of:
questions.explanation: AYUSHMAN BHARAT - PMJAY (world's LARGEST health insurance scheme) launched 23 September 2018 by PM Modi from Ranchi. Covers ~12 crore poor & vulnerable families (55 crore individuals) identified from SECC 2011 database. Provides ₹5 LAKH PER FAMILY PER YEAR for SECONDARY & TERTIARY care hospitalisation at empanelled public/private hospitals. Covers ~1,900 medical procedures. No premium — fully paid by government (60% Centre + 40% States; 90:10 for NE + 3 Himalayan states). AYUSHMAN BHARAT has TWO pillars: (1) PMJAY (health insurance); (2) HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRES (HWCs — upgraded Sub-Health Centres + PHCs providing comprehensive primary care). Extended in 2024 budget to ALL senior citizens ≥ 70 years, regardless of economic status (up to ₹5L top-up). Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM): universal health IDs (ABHA). secondary & tertiary hospitalisation.

questions.stem: PM MUDRA YOJANA (PMMY), launched April 2015, provides collateral-free loans to micro-enterprises under three categories. What are they?
questions.explanation: PMMY three categories: SHISHU (up to ₹50,000 — for business start), KISHOR (₹50,001 - ₹5 lakh — for expansion), TARUN (₹5 lakh - ₹10 lakh — for further growth). Budget 2024 announced extension: TARUN+ category up to ₹20 LAKH for entrepreneurs who have repaid Tarun loans. Loans given by: Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks, MFIs, NBFCs. No collateral required. Target beneficiaries: non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises (manufacturing, services, trading). Refinance provided by MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd — a subsidiary of SIDBI). >45 crore loans disbursed cumulatively since launch. Overall disbursement crossed ₹29 lakh crore by 2024.

questions.stem: The MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) guarantees:

options.option_text: 100 days of unskilled manual labour per rural household per financial year
Subsidised food grains at ration shops
Free healthcare up to ₹5 lakh per family

questions.explanation: MGNREGA — enacted SEPTEMBER 2005 as NREGA, renamed MGNREGA in 2009. World's largest employment guarantee programme. Provides 100 DAYS of guaranteed wage employment per financial year to ADULT MEMBERS of any rural household willing to do UNSKILLED manual work. Work must be provided within 5 km radius or compensation (wage + travel). If no work within 15 days → UNEMPLOYMENT ALLOWANCE. Wages paid within 15 days (DBT to bank accounts). State wage rates vary (~₹200-350/day). Typical works: water conservation, drought-proofing, flood management, rural connectivity, land development. Nodal ministry: RURAL DEVELOPMENT. 100% central funded for unskilled wages; 75:25 for materials/equipment. COVID-era: 100 days boosted to 150 in some states. Job card = ID. Social audit is mandatory.

questions.stem: Under PRADHAN MANTRI JAN DHAN YOJANA (PMJDY), what is the key feature of the basic zero-balance account provided?

options.option_text: No minimum balance required + RuPay debit card + ₹10,000 overdraft (post 6 months of good conduct) + accident/life insurance cover
Free gold loan up to ₹1 lakh

questions.explanation: PMJDY launched 28 AUGUST 2014 — aims at universal FINANCIAL INCLUSION. Features of Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA): (1) No minimum balance requirement; (2) FREE RuPay debit card; (3) ACCIDENTAL insurance cover of ₹1 lakh (raised to ₹2 lakh for new accounts from Aug 2018); (4) LIFE insurance of ₹30,000 for accounts opened between 15 Aug 2014 – 31 Jan 2015; (5) Overdraft of up to ₹10,000 (raised from ₹5k, 2018) after 6 months of SATISFACTORY operation; (6) Access to Pension and Insurance products. By 2024, >52 crore Jan Dhan accounts opened with deposits >₹2.17 lakh crore. PMJDY + AADHAAR + MOBILE = 'JAM TRINITY' — backbone of DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer), saving government ~₹2.7 lakh crore via plugging leakages.

questions.stem: ATAL PENSION YOJANA (APY), launched in 2015, is open to ALL Indian citizens in the age group:
questions.explanation: APY launched 9 May 2015 — a pension scheme targeting UNORGANISED SECTOR workers. Age eligibility: 18-40 YEARS. Contribution for minimum 20 years → monthly pension after 60 years. Guaranteed PENSION: ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000 / ₹4,000 / ₹5,000 per month (subscriber's choice). Contribution varies with age at entry & desired pension: e.g., at age 18, ₹42/month for ₹1,000 pension; at age 40, ₹291/month for ₹1,000. Administered by PFRDA (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority). DBT to bank account. Open to all Indians but primarily informal sector; excluded: existing social security beneficiaries + income tax payers (as of Oct 2022 amendment). Replaced the earlier Swavalamban Yojana (2010-11). Name commemorates former PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

questions.stem: STAND-UP INDIA scheme facilitates bank loans to SC/ST and WOMEN entrepreneurs in what range?
questions.explanation: STAND-UP INDIA launched 5 April 2016 by PM Modi. Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 LAKH and ₹1 CRORE to AT LEAST ONE SC/ST AND ONE WOMAN borrower per bank branch for setting up a GREENFIELD (new) enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading sector (agri-allied activities from 2018). Loan tenure: up to 7 years (18-month moratorium). Extended till 2025 in Budget 2019. Implementation: SIDBI + NABARD refinance. As of 2024, over 2 lakh loans sanctioned, disbursal crossing ₹45,000 crore — 80%+ to women entrepreneurs. Related schemes targeting marginalised: Stand-Up India (SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs), PM Vishwakarma (artisans, 2023), SVANidhi (street vendors, 2020).

questions.stem: PM-KISAN is to farmers what PM-SVANidhi is to:
questions.explanation: PM SVANidhi = Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi — launched 1 June 2020 during COVID to support street vendors affected by lockdowns. Provides COLLATERAL-FREE WORKING CAPITAL LOANS: first ₹10,000 (12-month tenure) → repaid fully → second loan ₹20,000 → ₹50,000. Interest subsidy of 7% per annum for timely repayment. Incentive for digital transactions: up to ₹1,200 cashback/year. Nodal: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). Over 70 lakh loans disbursed by 2024. Similar targeted schemes: PM VISHWAKARMA (Sept 2023 — 18 traditional artisan trades like carpenter, blacksmith, cobbler, tailor — ₹1 lakh collateral-free loan + skill training + ₹15k toolkit), PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat health), PM-KISAN (farmers), PM Ujjwala Yojana (2016 — LPG connections to BPL women).

questions.stem: Under BETI BACHAO BETI PADHAO (BBBP) scheme, the initial focus was on reversing the declining CHILD SEX RATIO (CSR). In 2011 Census, India's CSR was 918 girls per 1000 boys. BBBP was launched from which location?
questions.explanation: BETI BACHAO BETI PADHAO (BBBP — 'Save daughter, teach daughter') launched on 22 January 2015 by PM Modi from PANIPAT, HARYANA. Haryana was chosen because of its historically SKEWED CHILD SEX RATIO (CSR was ~834 in 2011 — among India's worst). Tri-ministerial: Ministry of Women and Child Development (nodal) + Health & Family Welfare + Education. Objectives: (1) prevent gender-biased sex-selective elimination (female foeticide); (2) ensure survival & protection of girl child; (3) education & participation. Linked schemes: SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI YOJANA (Jan 2015 — savings for girl child, highest interest rate among small savings at 8.2%), Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (2023, 2-year 7.5%). CSR improved to 929 per 2022 SRS data. Additional: One Stop Centre (OSC) for women in distress — 'Sakhi' scheme.

questions.stem: SWACHH BHARAT ABHIYAN (Clean India Mission) was launched on October 2, 2014 — on the birth anniversary of whom, and what was the target year for its initial rural sanitation goals?
questions.explanation: SWACHH BHARAT ABHIYAN / Clean India Mission (SBM) launched by PM Modi on 2 OCTOBER 2014 — Mahatma GANDHI'S 145th birth anniversary. Target: OPEN DEFECATION FREE (ODF) India by 2 October 2019 (Gandhi's 150th birth anniversary). TWO pillars: (1) SBM-GRAMIN (rural — Ministry of Jal Shakti); (2) SBM-URBAN (Ministry of Housing + Urban Affairs). Achievements by Oct 2019: >10 crore individual household latrines (IHHLs) built, all villages declared ODF. SBM Phase 2 (2020-25): ODF Plus — sustain + solid/liquid waste management + waste segregation. Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) launched Oct 2022 at COP27 to complement. Gandhi is also the National Father, depicted on all Indian rupee notes. Bharat Ratna posthumous? No — never awarded (Congress argued he didn't need it). his 150th birth anniversary.

questions.stem: Under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), what is the maximum premium rate payable by a farmer for Rabi food and oilseed crops?

options.option_text: 2% of the sum insured, same as for Kharif crops
1.5% of the sum insured, rest borne by Centre and State
5% of the sum insured, same as horticulture crops
3% of the sum insured, with uniform subsidy across crops

questions.explanation: Under PMFBY, farmers pay a maximum of 1.5% of sum insured for Rabi food and oilseed crops; the remaining actuarial premium is shared equally by Central and State governments. The 2% rate applies to Kharif crops — the most tempting distractor — and 5% applies to annual commercial/horticulture crops. Candidates mix up seasonal rates, making 2% the classic wrong pick.

questions.stem: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), which provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households, is implemented by which Union Ministry?

options.option_text: Ministry of Women and Child Development, New Delhi
Ministry of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

questions.explanation: PMUY is implemented by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas because LPG distribution falls under its mandate. Ministry of Women and Child Development is the most tempting distractor since the scheme targets BPL women, but the subject matter — fuel and gas connections — determines the nodal ministry, not the target demographic.

questions.stem: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Urban (PMAY-U), which vertical specifically uses 'land as a resource' and provides central assistance of ₹1 lakh per household through private developer participation?

options.option_text: Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) with state agencies
Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) for MIG households
In-Situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR) with private sector

questions.explanation: The ISSR component redevelops existing slums by leveraging their land value, using private developers to provide free housing to slum dwellers in exchange for FSI benefits; central assistance is ₹1 lakh per house. AHP and BLC each provide ₹1.5 lakh — candidates frequently confuse these amounts. CLSS works via interest subsidy on home loans, not direct construction grants.

questions.stem: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) mobilises rural poor women into which PRIMARY institutional structure at the grassroots to enable credit linkage and livelihood services?

options.option_text: Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) linked to NABARD credit
Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) supervised by district-level banks
Self-Help Groups (SHGs) federated into Village Organisations
Common Service Centres (CSCs) at gram panchayat level

questions.explanation: DAY-NRLM organises poor women into SHGs (10–20 members), then federates them into Village Organisations (VOs) and Cluster Level Federations (CLFs) — this three-tier structure is the mission's institutional hallmark. JLGs are the classic distractor: they are similarly small groups but lack the federation hierarchy and are used mostly in agriculture/fisheries credit, not the NRLM framework.

questions.stem: PM POSHAN Shakti Nirman (rechristened from Mid-Day Meal Scheme in 2021) primarily covers children in which educational stage to address classroom hunger and school dropout?

options.option_text: Anganwadi children aged 3–6 years under the ICDS framework
Students in Classes I–VIII in government and government-aided schools
Out-of-school adolescent girls aged 11–14 under Kishori Yojana
Residential tribal school students up to Class XII (Eklavya Schools)

questions.explanation: PM POSHAN covers Classes I–VIII in government and government-aided schools (the 6–14 age group aligned with the Right to Education Act). Anganwadi children (3–6 years) receive supplementary nutrition under a separate ICDS programme — the most common distractor. The scheme was renamed in 2021 but its core beneficiary group remained unchanged.

questions.stem: Under PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthan Mahabhiyan), Component-B is distinct from Components A and C because it specifically aims to:

options.option_text: Set up grid-connected renewable energy plants up to 2 MW on barren farmland
Solarise existing grid-connected agricultural pumps of individual farmers
Install standalone off-grid solar pumps replacing diesel water pumps
Create solar micro-grids supplying power to farmer cooperative clusters

questions.explanation: PM-KUSUM: Component A = decentralised renewable plants (≤2 MW) by farmers on barren land; Component B = solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps (reduces farmers' electricity bills); Component C = standalone off-grid solar pumps replacing diesel pumps in un-electrified areas. Component C is the standard wrong answer because it also involves solar pumps, but C targets un-electrified areas while B upgrades already grid-connected infrastructure.

questions.stem: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) includes an 'Annapurna' component. Which statement correctly captures what distinguishes Annapurna from the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)?

options.option_text: Annapurna targets destitute widows; IGNOAPS targets all seniors above 60
Annapurna provides 10 kg free food grain monthly to seniors NOT covered by IGNOAPS
Annapurna provides a monthly cash pension; IGNOAPS provides food grains instead
Annapurna is entirely state-funded; IGNOAPS is centrally sponsored under NSAP

questions.explanation: Annapurna specifically targets indigent senior citizens (65+) who are eligible for old-age pension but are NOT receiving IGNOAPS benefits — it provides 10 kg of food grain free per month as food security for this excluded group. IGNOAPS provides cash (₹200–500/month), not food; Option C reverses the nature of the two schemes, which is the most dangerous distractor. Both components are centrally sponsored under NSAP, making Option D incorrect.
